subject.title: [Feature] 6 项改进建议：CLI 优先级、SecretRef 文档、update 透明化、token 登录、自愈审计

question: Which remaining parts of this bundled request should OpenClaw core accept now, and should they be split into separate systemd SecretRef docs, update diff/reporting, and audit-surface issues?
rationale: Current main already implements several requested pieces, while the remaining pieces cross security, config-update compatibility, docs, and persistent audit policy; automation cannot choose that product boundary safely.

options.title: Split remaining gaps
options.body: Keep this open long enough for maintainers to create or point to narrow follow-ups for systemd SecretRef docs, update config diff/reporting, and self-healing audit semantics.

options.title: Close as mostly covered
options.body: Close this umbrella if maintainers decide current docs, update dry-run, openclaw audit, config-audit logs, and related trackers are sufficient for now.

options.title: Sponsor a safe-update feature
options.body: Promote the contributor gist into a broader core safe-update/audit design, accepting the larger product and compatibility review cost.

recommendation.title: Split remaining gaps
recommendation.body: Keep this open long enough for maintainers to create or point to narrow follow-ups for systemd SecretRef docs, update config diff/reporting, and self-healing audit semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: This crosses audit, config safety, Gateway, and product-direction surfaces where steipete has the strongest observed recent history signal.
